prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” HVAC company for AC repair in Houston — the right choice depends on your ZIP code, whether it’s a residential or commercial job, how quickly you need service, what brand of equipment you have, and your budget. I can help you find the best option for your situation. A few quick options and next steps:

If you want me to pick local companies for you
- Tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial (and whether it’s an emergency). I’ll pull a short list of top-rated, nearby AC repair companies with recent review summaries and contact info.

How to pick the best HVAC company for AC repair
- Check nearby reputation: recent Google/Yelp reviews, Angi/HomeAdvisor, and Better Business Bureau complaints.
- Verify credentials: technicians should have EPA Section 608 refrigerant certification; confirm the company carries liability insurance and (if required in your area) any local licenses/registrations.
- Ask about experience with your unit brand/model.
- Get written estimates from 2–3 companies (diagnostic fee, parts & labor, taxes).
- Confirm warranties: parts and labor and how long they last.
- Ask about emergency/same-day availability if you need it now.
- Ask whether they use flat-rate pricing or time-and-materials and whether permits will be pulled for repairs requiring them.
- Get references or recent customer examples, especially for larger repairs.

Well-known companies that serve Houston (examples to consider; verify for your area)
- John Moore Services (large, Houston-based; offers 24/7 service)
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (national brand with local presence)
- Local HVAC franchises (One Hour Heating & Air, local independent shops)

If you share your ZIP code and whether you want same-day service, I’ll find 3–5 well-reviewed HVAC companies near you, summarize their ratings/hours/warranties, and recommend which to call first.
